research_goal: Locate significant behavioral FFN output functions and actual source-based computation structures before quant/observer optimization
methodological_math: Finite intervention defines context-dependent functional role, necessity/sufficiency and path faithfulness; no unique circuit guarantee

papers.title: Causal Abstraction: A Theoretical Foundation for Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.mechanism: Low-level to high-level causal abstraction, intervention and graded faithfulness, distributed feature identity
papers.transfer: Requires calibrated definition of video behavior and actual Wan path; not directly an FFN detector

papers.title: Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods
papers.mechanism: Patching localization changes with corruption choice and scoring metric
papers.transfer: Model domain LLM, Wan causal intervention has yet to be tested

papers.title: Is This the Subspace You Are Looking for? An Interpretability Illusion for Subspace Activation Patching
papers.mechanism: Subspace patch effect may activate dormant parallel path unconnected to normal computation
papers.transfer: Needed to distinguish induced steering behavior from original Wan function-carrying path

papers.title: TIDE: Temporal-Aware Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretable Diffusion Transformers in Image Generation
papers.mechanism: Timestep-aware SAE captures conceptual hierarchy and enabling image DiT steering
papers.transfer: Image DiT features and SAE training not native Wan I2V function necessity

papers.title: I'm a Map! Interpretable Motion-Attentive Maps: Spatio-Temporally Localizing Concepts in Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.mechanism: GramCol and IMAP maps localize when/where motion concepts influence video DiT, gradient-free, training-free
papers.transfer: Per-frame concept saliency is not a causal W1/W2 functional circuit or acceleration proof

papers.title: Interpreting Video Representations with Spatio-Temporal Sparse Autoencoders
papers.mechanism: Hard TopK video encoder SAE features can lose temporal autocorrelation; contrastive temporal objective restores temporal integrity
papers.transfer: DINOv2/VideoMAE encoder features, not diffusion video generator original FFN
